newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss Re sees higher 1996 profit.
newsitem.headline: Swiss Re sees higher 1996 profit.

text.p: Swiss Reinsurance Co expects significantly better 1996 results, barring any unforeseen events, chief executive Lukas Muehlemann said.

"For the business year 1996 which is nearly over we expect from today's point of view another significant improvement in profits, assuming no great damages or natural catastrophe occur and no seriously negative events take place in securities markets," he said.
The remarks were made in the text of a speech prepared for delivery at the company's annual shareholder's meeting.
Swiss Re's 1995 group net profit rose by 54 percent from the previous year to 1,092 million Swiss francs. -- Zurich Editorial +41 1 631 7340
